How to use an acupressure mat correctly

There isn’t necessarily a “wrong” way to use an acupressure mat — if you simply lay on top of it, you’re doing it right. But to help make your sessions as impactful as possible, experts share their tips below. An important one to know right off the bat: The spikes on your acupressure mat should make contact with your skin for maximum efficacy, says Kirstin Bunton, a licensed acupuncturist and the head of healer development at WTHN, an acupuncture and Traditional Chinese Medicine wellness studio. (Ed’s note: The inclusion of products sold by Wthn in this article was made independently of Bunton.) If you find that uncomfortable, especially if you’re a beginner, she recommends using the mat while wearing thin clothing rather than thick, bulky garments.
The best acupressure mat position for you depends on the area you’re targeting, says Bunton.
You can turn it horizontally and vertically depending on the part of your body you want it to cover. Some positions to consider include:

Laying on it supine to cover your back from the shoulders to the hips, or moving it down to cover the backs of your legs from the hips to the ankles Laying on it prone to cover the front of the legs from the hips to the anklesSitting in a chair and putting it on the seat to cover your bottom and the back of your thighs; putting behind your on your back to cover from your shoulders to your hips; or putting it on the floor under your bare feet.
Laying on it supine to cover your back from the shoulders to the hips, or moving it down to cover the backs of your legs from the hips to the ankles
Laying on it prone to cover the front of the legs from the hips to the ankles

Sitting in a chair and putting it on the seat to cover your bottom and the back of your thighs; putting behind your on your back to cover from your shoulders to your hips; or putting it on the floor under your bare feet.
Standing on it, which causes an intense sensation that only experienced users should try
Standing on it, which causes an intense sensation that only experienced users should try

Beginners should aim to use an acupressure mat for about 10 to 20 minutes at a time, says Dr. Scott Kaylor, a physical therapist and clinic owner at Zone Physical Therapy who’s affiliated with Stride, a custom orthotics and insoles brand. As your body gets used to it, you can increase the duration, but remember that longer sessions aren’t always better. In fact, consistency matters more than duration. “Using the mat briefly and comfortably tends to be more beneficial than pushing through excessive discomfort for long periods of time,” he says.

Signs that you’re using an acupressure mat for too long include general discomfort and overstimulation, numbness, dizziness and skin irritation during and after a session, says Crawford. You should only feel calmer, looser and more grounded once your body settles in — anything else is a red flag.
You can use an acupressure mat daily, but as your body is getting used to it, start with a few times a week, says Crawford.
Frequently asked questions

There’s limited studies available around the efficacy of acupressure mats, but generally, experts say they work to temporarily reduce discomfort, pain and tension when you use them as a tool within a broader recovery routine. They’re not a standalone solution, so if you’re dealing with consistent issues, it’s important to see a professional, says Kaylor.

The main benefit of acupressure mats is increased circulation in targeted areas, which helps your muscles relax to temporarily relieve discomfort, pain and tension, says Bunton. They’re especially useful tools for people who are stiff after sitting or standing for prolonged periods of time, do repetitive movements that can create tightness, or experience exercise-related soreness, says Kaylor.

Crawford says acupressure mats can also help with decreasing stress levels. “One of the biggest benefits is simply creating intentional time for stillness, rest and recovery, which many people are missing in their day-to-day lives,” she says. That relates to sleep quality and quantity, too. Bunton says some of her clients who deal with sleeping issues like insomnia tend to overthink when they get in bed, preventing them from being able to drift into a slumber. She recommends laying on an acupressure mat right before bed because it signals to your body that it’s time to slow down and decompress, and relaxes the muscles in the head and neck area.

Because acupressure mats are covered in spikes that apply pressure to your skin, they can feel quite intense at first, but they shouldn’t ever be painful, says Kaylor. Using them should lead to a tolerable, manageable amount of stimulation that’s eventually relaxing and has a somewhat warm sensation. Try pairing an acupressure mat session with deep breathing, meditation or mindfulness to encourage your nervous system to settle down, says Crawford.

Acupressure mats are generally safe for most people to use, says Bunton. But experts say you should speak with your doctor before trying one if you have certain medical conditions, including the following: bleeding, circulation and clotting disorders; neuropathy; skin conditions like infections and open wounds; uncontrolled diabetes and/or diabetes-related sensation issues; chronic pain;  significant sensory impairments or sensitivity. Also consult your doctor if you’re pregnant or recovering from an injury or surgery.

Acupuncture and acupressure are both practices rooted in Traditional Chinese Medicine that center around stimulating specific points across the body, says Kaylor. They differ in terms of how you or a licensed practitioner apply that stimulation.

During acupuncture, a licensed practitioner applies stimulation with very fine needles placed in targeted points across your body, says Crawford.During acupressure, you, a practitioner or a tool with a textured surface applies stimulation through physical pressure to targeted areas, says Kaylor. Unlike acupuncture, you can do acupressure at home, so it’s a more accessible option for most people and you can do it between professional acupuncture treatments.
During acupuncture, a licensed practitioner applies stimulation with very fine needles placed in targeted points across your body, says Crawford.

During acupressure, you, a practitioner or a tool with a textured surface applies stimulation through physical pressure to targeted areas, says Kaylor. Unlike acupuncture, you can do acupressure at home, so it’s a more accessible option for most people and you can do it between professional acupuncture treatments.

Yes, acupressure mats are the same as acupuncture mats. “Acupressure mat” is the correct term for the tool. There’s technically no such thing as an acupuncture mat — acupuncture involves stimulating specific points by inserting thin needles into the skin, while acupressure involves stimulation through physical pressure.

title: Which ‘Legally Blonde’ Character You Are, Based on Your Zodiac Sign
summary: July 13, 2026 is the 25th anniversary of Legally Blonde. Here’s what to know about all the characters and their zodiac signs.
story: "Legally Blond" is nearing its Saturn return! The movie turned 25 on July 13, 2026, and its pop culture legacy is as strong as ever.
The prequel series “Elle,” which premiered earlier this year, follows the world’s most famous Gemini back when she was in high school.
“Legally Blonde” and “Elle” are showing, after all this time, that nothing should stop you from going after your dreams ... and wearing pink as you do.
For fun, here’s a look at who you are based on your zodiac sign.
Aries: Vivian Kensington

Vivian (Selma Blair) has a competitive side that comes out in and out of the classroom. Her combative nature aligns her with the fire sign Aries. Like the ram, who initially wants to win at all costs, but later realizes that they should suss out matters before acting impulsively on their emotions.
Taurus: Kyle O’Boyle

Kyle (Bruce Thomas) is the UPS guy who flirts with Paulette at the beauty salon in town. His rizz and charm align Kyle with the zodiac sign Taurus. Even though the bend and snap backfired and Paulette hit him in the nose, Kyle’s fixed energy keeps the good vibes and romance intact.
Gemini: Elle Woods

Elle (Reese Witherspoon) is a self-described “Gemini vegetarian,” like her dog, Brewster. Her fast-talking abilities, intellect, directness, and desire to have fun make her the ultimate Gemini. There is more depth to her than people assume. All of these reasons are insight into why Elle aligns with the air sign.
Cancer: Warner Huntington III

Warner (Matthew Davis) adheres to what his family thinks is best, making him a Cancer since they are close with their brood. Warner is also a player, and Cancer men do have a rep on TikTok for moving to and from different relationships on a whim.
Leo: Mrs. Windham-Vandermark

When Mrs. Windham-Vandermark (Raquel Welch) enters the courtroom, she exudes big Leo energy. Maybe it is her flair for over-the-top fashion or her act while testifying on the stand, but the one sure giveaway is her loyalty to Chutney (her daughter) and the diva-like vibe she puts out there in the film.
Virgo: David

David has a lot of knowledge as well as a wealth of statistics and facts about the law and other areas (due to his diverse background), which connects him to book-smart Virgo. His respectable, chill and kind demeanor is in sync with how the earth sign handles situations and friendships.
Libra: Emmett Richmond

Emmett (Luke Wilson) is sympathetic to Elle when she’s kicked out of class, proving that he has a sweet and gentle demeanor, like most Libras. His willingness to listen to her issues demonstrates that he is a true air sign with a heart of gold, making those who bear the scales proud.
Scorpio: Brooke Taylor-Windham

Scorpios are secretive, similarly to how Brooke (Ali Larter) handles her alibi. Rather than have her business be known, she’d rather be charged with a crime and sentenced to prison (relatable content for Scorpio). Clandestine behavior is a flex since they’re highly guarded and don’t want their personal life shared with everyone.
Sagittarius: Professor Elspeth Stromwell

Professor Stormwell (Holland Taylor) is tough, but genuinely cares about the law and students. She inspires Elle when she needs it, saying, “If you’re going to let one stupid prick ruin your life ... you’re not the girl I thought you were.” The archer is the motivator and teacher, like Stromwell.
Capricorn: Professor Aaron Callahan

Professor Callahan (Victor Garber) prioritizes his work and takes a calculated approach to gaining the respect of his pupils by urging them to fight for an internship. Capricorns demand excellence in their careers and those they take under their wing, like Callahan (even though he turns out to be a not-so-nice person).
Aquarius: Paulette Bonafonté

Paulette (Jennifer Coolidge) is a ride-or-die pal and a fantastic nail technician. Her quirky sense of humor aligns with the water bearer’s unique communication style and essence. Tried and true, she is always there for Elle, which is how Aquarians usually are with their best buds (they are the sign of friendship).
Pisces: Chutney Windham

Chutney (Linda Cardellini) is one of the movie’s antagonists who killed her father by accident. Her emotional declaration in court resembles the sentiments of Pisces, a water sign who gets deep into their feels. She may be a perjurer and guilty, but it’s a crime of the heart, which is how Pisces would act out.

title: Jason Kelce Says His Daughters Were ‘Incredible’ as Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Flower Girls
summary: Jason Kelce and Kylie Kelce’s four daughters played a special role in their uncle Travis Kelce’s wedding to Taylor Swift.
story: Jason Kelce and Kylie Kelce’s daughters played a big role in their NFL star uncle Travis Kelce’s wedding to Taylor Swift.

The couple’s four little girls — Wyatt, 6, Elliotte, 5, Bennett, 3, and Finnley, 1 — served as flower girls when the Kansas City Chiefs tight end tied the knot with the pop star during a star-studded wedding at New York City’s Madison Square Garden on July 3.

“It was a special event for our entire family, and obviously my daughters are incredible,” Jason Kelce, 38, told the Reno Gazette Journal while he was competing in the American Century Championship celebrity golf tournament at the Edgewood Tahoe Resort in Nevada on July 11.
“They’re beautiful, they’re incredible personalities,” the proud dad added of his daughters. “And Travis and Taylor love them.”
The retired Philadelphia Eagle served as his younger brother’s best man during the ceremony.
Swift’s younger brother Austin Swift served as her “Man of Honor.”
“So, very happy we were able to be a part of it,” Jason Kelce said of the couple’s nuptials. “And more importantly, very happy for those two. It was an amazing day.”
Sports commentator Rich Eisen previously confirmed to “Entertainment Tonight” that Jason Kelce and Kylie Kelce’s daughters were flower girls during the ceremony.

“The Kelce family is just awesome. You know, Kylie as well. Those four little girls who were sprinkling flower petals all over the place. It’s pretty cool, dude. It’s pretty cool,” said Eisen, who previously described the wedding as a “storybook” event.
Jason Kelce isn’t the only member of the Kelce family to break their silence about the couple’s lavish wedding ceremony.
The Kelce brothers’ mom, Donna Kelce, gave the event two thumbs up when she was asked about it at the Macy’s fireworks show on July 4.
The NFL star mom said in a video, “I really can’t say a heck of a lot, except it was magical, man.”

title: ‘Summer House’ Season 11 Cast Revealed. Who’s Returning and Who Isn’t
summary: The cast for “Summer House” Season 11 has been revealed, with some old and familiar faces returning and some leaving.
story: Season 10 of “Summer House” may have gone out with a bang, but the drama isn’t over quite yet.
On July 13, Bravo announced that Season 11 is officially in production and revealed who is — and isn’t — returning to the Hamptons.

After “Summer House” was renewed for another season, viewers are eager to see how Amanda Batula and West Wilson’s controversial relationship could play out in future episodes. However, it appears the two might not be part of new episodes.

During the three-part “Summer House” Season 10 reunion, the show’s cast discussed some of the season’s biggest moments and broached a few touchy topics, including Batula and Wilson’s unexpected romance.

On March 31, the co-stars confirmed that they were dating, prompting several of their castmates to comment on their relationship, including Batula’s ex-husband, Kyle Cooke, and Wilson’s ex-girlfriend, Ciara Miller.
Bravo noted for fans to stay tuned for more details on the upcoming “Summer House” season. But for now, here is everything you need to know about the Season 11 cast.

title: Meet the 16 Dancers Competing in ‘Dancing With the Stars: The Next Pro’

As their journey begins, the 16 dancers will be tested on their jive and samba techniques, with the weakest pair eliminated during the first episode.

title: How Much of ‘The Five-Star Weekend’ Was Actually Filmed on Nantucket?
summary: Where was Five-Star Weekend filmed? INside the real locations on Nantucket island and what was actually filmed in Los Angeles.
story: In Peacock’s new hit series “The Five-Star Weekend,” its scenic Nantucket setting is so prominent, it’s practically an unofficial lead character.

Based on Elin Hilderbrand’s 2023 novel of the same name, “The Five-Star Weekend” tells the story of food influencer Hollis Shaw, played by Jennifer Garner, who grieves the sudden death of her physician husband.

Hollis invites close women friends from every stage of her life — played by Regina Hall, Chloë Sevigny, D’Arcy Carden and Gemma Chan — to join her for a girls getaway at her gorgeous Nantucket beach home.
The series depicts how locals on the Massachusetts island spend time on its sandy beaches and at its charming waterfront shops.
Viewers also get to enter inside some of Nantucket’s most beloved (and real) spots, including Bartlett’s Ocean View Farm, CRU Oyster Bar, The Chicken Box roadhouse bar and Wicked Island Bakery.
How much of “The Five-Star Weekend” was actually shot in Nantucket?
“Most of it was shot on a soundstage in Los Angeles,” Jennifer Garner said on TODAY with Jenna & Shienelle on July 13. “All the interiors.”
But the actual island figured into the show, too, which was a priority for Hilderbrand, who moved to the island herself after falling in love with it on a trip 30 years ago.

“The most wonderful thing other than the birth of my children was having ‘Five Stars’ shot on Nantucket because it is a singular place, it is unique and you can’t really imitate it,” the author said when she and Garner stopped by TODAY with Jenna and Sheinelle on July 13.
Shooting the series in another location and pretending it was Nantucket just wouldn’t have worked, added the author, who published “The Blue Book,” a guide to Nantucket in 2025.
Still, not all the island’s residents were as thrilled as Hilderbrand was to have the series filmed there.
“I feel like some of the locals pushed back a little bit because they didn’t want the disruption and also they were afraid of it becoming too popular,” said the author.
Hilderbrand is crossing her fingers that her fellow residents who watch the series will appreciate its authenticity.
“I hope when they see this show, they realize, OK, it was important that it was shot here,” she said.
Garner recalled the series’ cast and crew soaking up “every beautiful location” while filming. On their down time, they took advantage of Nantucket’s amenities.
“The cast was sailing together. We were out at dinner and doing karaoke together ... we played, we played hard,” Garner recalled.
Hilderbrand’s popularity among her fellow residents was what opened the door for them, Garner added.

Jenna Bush Hager Was Shocked By Her ‘Five-Star Weekend’ Cameo ... and Impressed!
Elin Hilderbrand Shares the Real Conversation That Inspired ‘The Five-Star Weekend’

“The only reason we were able to shoot there is because of how that island feels about you,” Garner told Hilderbrand. “And the way you embrace every business on that island. And every business on that island wants to please Elin.”
“She’s not just the queen of the beach reads, she’s the queen of Nantucket,” Jenna joked of Hilderbrand.
Garner also recalled the cast and crew being greeted by the author’s enthusiastic fans — who call themselves “Hilderbabes” — throughout the shoot.

“I mean, we were there in September ... and there would be little throngs of women going around on their girl trips to Nantucket because they love Elin’s books. And they’d be like, ‘We found them! We’ve been looking for you guys!’” she recalled.
“It was like we were a square on a bingo card,” she added.
Hilderbrand’s previous adaptation, “The Perfect Couple” on Netflix, was set in Nantucket but filmed elsewhere in Massachusetts.

title: New ‘Little House’ Series Features Original Nellie Oleson And She’s ‘Creepy As All Get-Out’
summary: Alison Arngrim played Nellie Oleson in the Michael Landon-helmed “Little House on the Prairie.” She returned in a cameo in the Netflix reboot of the series.
story: She had golden ringlets that were the envy of every girl in town, a sneer that could strike fear in your heart and her merchant parents supplied her with endless amounts of candy.
We hated her. We loved her. We were endlessly fascinated by her.

She is Nellie Oleson, as played by Alison Arngrim in the Michael Landon-helmed “Little House on the Prairie.” And much to viewers’ delight (and understandable fear) she returned in a cameo in the Netflix reboot of the series.
But this time, the curls were nowhere in sight.
The 64-year-old Arngrim appeared in the second episode of the new series wearing a dirty dress and a man’s coat and scarf. She had some particularly authentic-looking prairie teeth too.
“Bwahaha!” Arngrim posted on Instagram three days ago. “I had SOOOOO much fun doing this! So happy people are enjoying my cameo on the new Little House!”

Simply listed as “Ida” in IMDB.com, Arngrim’s character is “a drifter who Mary and Laura encounter in the woods.” Though Ida tries to coerce the Ingalls girls to stay with her for some seemingly nefarious reasons, they escape in the nick of time.

In an interview with Tudum, Arngrim praised Alice Halsey and Skywalker Hughes, the actors who play Laura and Mary. “These little girls have résumés longer than some people who are 40 or 50 years old, and they’re 12,” she said.

Arngrim only had two weeks to prepare for the role of Ida. When she heard about her character’s role in the episode, she remembers thinking, “Oh, that’s creepy as all get‑out. That sounds right up my alley. I’ll be right over!”
In portraying Nellie in the original series, Arngrim said in the interview, “I was clearly the villain ... and yet people talk about me as iconic and say they love Nellie. They can’t get enough.”
Even so, Arngrim isn’t precious about a new actor taking over the role.

“I’ve been waiting for the new Nellie for years,” she said. “Realize — and this is the tough part — if you do this correctly, there will be people who will hate you — and think the show is real. It’s like playing Hannibal Lecter. If you do it right, people will flip out.”

title: Elin Hilderbrand Shares the Real Conversation That Inspired ‘Five Star Weekend’
summary: Elin Hilderbrand says a friend’s real-life girls trip inspired her bestselling novel “The Five-Star Weekend,” which has been turned into a hit Peacock series starring Jennifer Garner.
story: Elin Hilderbrand says a friend’s real-life girls trip inspired her bestselling novel “The Five-Star Weekend,” which has been turned into a hit Peacock series starring Jennifer Garner.
On July 13, Hilderbrand and Garner stopped by TODAY with Jenna and Sheinelle, where Hilderbrand shared details about a conversation with a friend that gave her the idea for her story.
In the book and the series, Garner plays Hollis Shaw, a popular food influencer who is coping with the sudden death of her heart surgeon husband, Matthew (Josh Hamilton).

Hollis invites several close friends from different eras of her life to her glam Nantucket beach house for a “five-star” weekend filled with gourmet food, spa treatments and girl talk among the five women.

The twist? Hollis’ friends — played by Regina Hall, Chloë Sevigny, D’Arcy Carden and Gemma Chan — don’t all necessary get along. The women bond and bicker while each takes pains to keep secrets about their own lives from the rest of the group.
Hilderbrand said she got the idea for the novel after meeting up with a friend who was participating in a similar weekend.

“So I got a text from a fellow writer in the fall of 2020 asking me to meet for a drink,” Hilderbrand told Jenna and Sheinelle. “If you remember, we weren’t really doing that in the fall of 2020. But I met her and we were the only people in the restaurant.”
During their conversation, Hilderbrand learned her friend was on a “girls’ weekend,” organized by someone who’d been diagnosed with terminal cancer.
The friend explained to Hilderbrand that the woman had invited “all the most important people in her life” to have “one weekend in Nantucket.”
But Hilderbrand’s friend then confided: “Not all of us are getting along.”
“Oh my goodness, this is a novel,” she recalled telling her friend.
“Well, it’s a Elin Hilderbrand novel,” she said her friend joked.
Hilderbrand’s friend forbade her from sharing certain details that might reveal too much about the women on her girls’ trip.
“Which I very much respected,” Hilderbrand said.
“I just created the novel from that interaction,” she added of the conversation.
Like the show’s premise, the actors of “The Five Star Weekend” didn’t know each other before filming. Garner said on TODAY they all met for the first time at the table read.

“Your female friends are everything. They’re the breath of life. So to get to focus on that and make these great real friendships. I mean our text chain has been going off for the past year, ‘The Five Stars,’” Garner said.
Working alongside four other lead female actors is what drew Garner to the role, she said.
“(It) turned out to be better than something I even could have dreamed,” she said.

title: Laura Dern Mourns Death of ‘Beloved’ ‘Jurassic Park’ Co-Star Sam Neill
summary: Laura Dern is mourning the death of her “Jurassic Park” co-star Sam Neill.
story: Laura Dern is mourning the death of her “Jurassic Park” co-star Sam Neill, who died at the age of 78 in Australia, his family announced July 13.

“Sam was my beloved lifetime friend… He showed me the depths of loyalty, protectiveness and love always with the driest of wit. He was a true and noble gentleman, wrapped up in my dream leading man,” she said in a statement shared with NBC News.
“I will love you forever, Dr. Alan Grant,” she added, referring to his character in the hit 1993 movie.

In “Jurassic Park,” Dern played Dr. Ellie Sattler, a professional colleague and romantic interest for the paleontologist Grant. Neill and Dern would reprise their roles in 2001’s “Jurassic Park III” and 2022’s “Jurassic World: Dominion.”
Neill’s family announced his death on Instagram. No cause of death was provided.
“Sam was surrounded by family and passed with the dignity that has characterized his whole life,” the family said in a statement.
Neill revealed in April of this year he was cancer-free. He first opened up about his diagnosis with blood cancer, specifically angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, in 2023.
“The loss was sudden and unexpected but blessed by the fact that Sam remained cancer free,” his family said in the statement.
Neill’s death sparked an outpouring of tributes to the actor.

“Sam Neill was a deeply soulful and beautiful man,” “Jurassic World” and “Jurassic World: Dominion” director Colin Trevorrow wrote on Instagram. “He was a friend and collaborator at a challenging time, and his strength gave us all strength. I’ll remember him for his tranquility, his love of wine, and for the calm assuredness he brought to his characters. It’s not every lifetime you get to befriend a legend. Forever grateful.

“Sam Neill starred in so many beloved Australian stories and he earned a special place in Australian hearts,” Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese wrote on X. “Wry and dry, thoughtful and laconic, Sam fought illness with the same dignity, humour and conviction that gave strength to his every performance. He will be much mourned and long remembered. May he rest in peace.

“Heartfelt condolences to your whānau,” Neill’s “Thor: Ragnarok” co-star Karl Urban commented on the post announcing his death, referring to the actor’s family. “Sam was truly brilliant. An inspiration for many who followed in his trailblazing footsteps. A beautiful man , A national treasure who gave so much to New Zealand and the to world God speed Sam.”

“I love you, dear Sam. You hero. You legend. You sweetheart. Our great friend. You are already missed so very much. Continue in peace wherever you are,” Toni Collette, who starred with Neill in the films “A Long Way Down” and “Dirty Deeds,” wrote on Instagram.

title: Every Surprise Guest at Jay-Z’s Star-Packed Yankee Stadium Album Anniversary Shows
summary: The final night of Jay-Z’s Yankee Stadium anniversary concert series was still a star-studded affair after an hourslong delay caused by a security breach.
story: The final night of Jay-Z’s Yankee Stadium anniversary concert series was still a star-studded affair after an hourslong delay caused by a security breach.

The 25-time Grammy Award-winning rapper performed for three nights in the Bronx, from July 10-12. He broke the record for most concert tickets sold at the sports arena on Night 2. He’s next set to perform in London, Paris and Los Angeles, with tickets available from Live Nation.
On July 12, the final show at Yankee Stadium was scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. but started around midnight. Jay-Z apologized onstage and said a safety issue prompted security to close the doors.

“Somebody rushed the door, and they closed the door for you guys’ safety and everybody’s safety outside,” he said in a video posted on X. “It’s 10,000 people outside. I don’t want to start music and people get trampled. I’m really sorry for the inconvenience but I had to make sure everybody’s OK.”
But the show was still unforgettable, with guests like Beyonce, Rihanna and more. Here’s every celebrity who made a stop at Yankee Stadium across Jay-Z’s anniversary residency.
July 10, Night 1

Jay-Z and Beyonce’s relationship is celebrating the same quarter-century milestone as his album “Blueprint.” The two met around 2000 and got married eight years later. The celebrity couple has three kids together, including their oldest, Blue Ivy Carter, who also appeared on stage.
The oldest of Jay-Z and Beyoncé’s three children did not waste her spotlight moment. Blue Ivy sat at the piano to perform “Feelin’ It” alongside her father, who released the hit song back in 1997.

Jay-Z and Nas had their fair share of lyrical beef back in the early 2000s, but the hip-hop and rap household names came together years later to celebrate Jay-Z’s first anniversary show. This is not the first time the two have reconciled on stage. In 2005, Nas and Jay-Z joined other legends of the genre at a radio concert event to set the record straight regarding their previous feud.
This girl was on fire at Night 1 of Jay-Z’s three-day Yankee Stadium run. Keys reunited with her collaborator on the 2009 hit “Empire State of Mind,” which took home two Grammy Awards.
July 11, Night 2

Jay-Z invited Slick Rick to sing his track “The Ruler’s Back,” a song by Jay-Z titled in honor of Rick’s 1991 album of the same name. This celebratory performance kicked off the second night of Jay-Z’s Yankee Stadium residency.

Eminem and Jay-Z joined forces for “Renegade,” a hit song from “Blueprint,” which Eminem performed Saturday night, followed by his hit, “Lose Yourself.” Eminem also worked as a producer for Jay-Z’s “Moment of Clarity” off “The Black Album” and the unreleased track “Syllables.” The two performed as co-headliners on the “Home & Home Tour” in 2010.

Pharrell Williams and Jay-Z previously worked together on a few projects, including Jay-Z’s 2000 club hit “I Just Wanna Love U (Give It 2 Me).” Jay-Z was also featured in the “Happy” singer’s track, “Frontin’,” in 2003. At Night 2 of Jay-Z’s show, Pharrell sang a few of their joint hits: “Excuse Me Miss,” “I Just Wanna Love U (Give It 2 Me),” “Frontin’” and “Allure.”
July 12, Night 3

Rihanna and Jay-Z have recorded together on “Umbrella,” “Run This Town” and “Talk That Talk.” Her appearance at the final show at Yankee Stadium marked the singer’s first live performance since 2024, when the 2023 Super Bowl Halftime performer sang at the Ambani family wedding. At Jay-Z’s July 12 show, she performed their joint hit “Run This Town” as well as “Bitch Better Have My Money.”
The 35-time Grammy-Award-winner returned to share the stage with her husband for a second time to close out the three-day residency. On Sunday, she sang “Drunk In Love.”
Usher joined his longtime friend and collaborator to perform “Throwback” and “Heart of the City (Ain’t No Love).”
The two reunited for a performance of “Money Ain’t a Thang,” which Dupri released in 1998 and features Jay-Z.
Williams gave the night’s crowd another medley performance of his hits with the headliner.
Clipse, the hip hop duo comprising Pusha T and Malice, has supported Jay-Z throughout his career, and the group sang their hit song “Grindin’” July 12 with the help of Williams.

Taylor performed Jay-Z’s collaborative hit with Mary J. Blige, “Can’t Knock the Hustle.” The song was released as part of “Reasonable Doubt.” Taylor and the Carter family notably go way back. Beyoncé first asked then 15-year-old Taylor to help choreograph in 2006.

Swizz Beatz served as a producer on Jay-Z’s “Blueprint” track “On To The Next One.” At the July 12 show, he joined Jay-Z for multiple songs, including “Money, Cash, Hoes,” “Jigga,” “On to the Next One” and “So Appalled.”
Jeezy sang the hit “Go Crazy (Remix),” a track Jay-Z originally featured on for Jeezy’s album “Let’s Get It: Thug Motivation 101.” He also joined in for “Seen It All.”
Fat Joe and Jay-Z had an alleged 20-year feud before making a truce with their collaboration on the “All the Way Up” remix. He joined Jay-Z for the song “New York.”
Jadakiss joined alongside Fat Joe for “New York.” The rapper has worked with Jay-Z on the multi-artist track “King Kong Riddim,” the remix of “Fiesta,” and “I Love the Dough.“
The R&B record producer, singer and writer co-wrote Jay-Z‘s “Holy Grail.” On Sunday’s concert, The-Dream assumed the role of Frank Ocean, singing his vocal parts for “No Church in the Wild”

title: Robert Pattinson Reveals Why He Hesitated When Asked to Join ‘The Odyssey’
summary: Robert Pattinson stars in Christopher Nolan’s epic “The Odyssey.” Find out why the “Twilight” actor initially hesitated joining the cast of the summer blockbuster.
story: By now everyone has heard of Christopher Nolan’s epic film “The Odyssey.” Landing in theaters on Friday, July 17, the new movie is being hailed as the summer’s biggest blockbuster, if not the cinematic event of the year.

Even so, Robert Pattinson, who plays Antinous, one of Penelope’s suitors, revealed during an interview with TODAY correspondent Kaylee Hartung that when Nolan first approached him to join the cast, he hesitated before signing on.

“My first thought always with a part is like, ‘I don’t know if I can do anything.’ But sometimes I get more scared if someone’s saying, just off the bat, ‘Do you want to do this thing?’” Pattinson said of his initial reaction. “My imposter syndrome kicks in very, very hard.”
Widely known for his role as Edward Cullen in the “Twilight” films and for playing the dark knight in “The Batman” franchise, Pattison previously worked with Nolan on the 2020 sci-fi film “Tenet.”

Despite his initial misgivings over teaming up with the director again, Pattinson ultimately accepted Nolan’s offer to play Antinous, the scheming suitor who plots to marry Penelope and destroy her son, Telemachus, played by Anne Hathaway and Tom Holland, respectively.
Should you need a primer, “The Odyssey” is based on Homer’s 12,100-line poem by the same name, approximately written down in the 7th century.
The legendary tale chronicles the journey of Odysseus, king of the Greek island of Ithaca, who leaves his wife, Penelope, and son, Telemachus, to lead the Trojan War.

After a decade of battle, Odysseus triumphs and begins the long voyage home. It’s a quest that takes him years. Along the way, he encounters a variety of life-and-death challenges handed down from the gods.
In his absence, dozens of opportunistic suiters descend upon his kingdom, each hoping to marry Penelope and steal the throne.
Among them? The sinister Antinous. While the character is arguably one of the biggest villains of the film, Pattison doesn’t quite see it that way.

“It’s funny,” he told TODAY. “I just think Antinous isn’t that bad. Like, I’m slightly worried now, because maybe if I watch it with an audience I’ll be, like, horrified. Because I watch it and I’m just like, ‘He’s just a guy.’”

Villain or not, Pattison said that he sees his character as having a certain glamour and to help get into character, he worked with the costume department to ensure that the materials used for his wardrobe gave Antinous the appearance of privilege and wealth, right down to his underwear.

“As soon as I read the script, I’m like, ‘I want to have cheetah underpants,’” he said. “I think Antinous is that kind of guy. He has this kind of sensuousness about him; ‘I just like pleasure.’ And so I was kind of thinking you want to have the most luxurious underpants he can.”

All underwear aside, Pattinson, whose performance in “The Odyssey” is already being widely acclaimed by critics, said that if Nolan comes calling for another film, there’ll be no hesitation this time.
“Oh yeah, for sure,” Pattinson said. “I basically said “yes.”

title: Charlize Theron Shares the ‘Biggest Surprise’ of Reuniting with Matt Damon on ‘The Odyssey’, 30 Years After Their 1st Movie Together
summary: Charlize Theron raved about working again with Matt Damon in “The Odyssey,” 26 years after they starred together in “The Legend of Bagger Vance.”
story: You could say that Charlize Theron and Matt Damon have been on their own professional odysseys since they first worked together, only to circle back in the highly anticipated blockbuster, “The Odyssey.”

Back in 2000, the pair starred in the golf drama “The Legend of Bagger Vance,” which also featured Will Smith. Theron says it was magical to reconnect in their new effort, which is director Christopher Nolan’s big screen adaptation of Homer’s epic poem “The Odyssey.”

“It was amazing. I think that was maybe for me the biggest surprise, was how sentimental it started to feel,” she said July 13 in a joint interview with “The Odyssey” co-stars Samantha Morton and Zendaya.
Theron says she was quickly able to soak in how far they’d come since “The Legend of Bagger Vance” while shooting “The Odyssey.”
“Like, we did the first take, and I just went, ‘Oh my God, we did this when we were babies,’ and here we are, two old humans,” she said.
The pair share several scenes in the movie — Damon plays Odysseus, while Theron portrays Calypso. She couldn’t stop gushing about him and how thrilled she was he ended up in the film.

“(He’s) just one of my favorite people, and it’s rare that you get to do something like that, you know, to experience the same experience, like 30 years later, and with someone as great and as wonderful,” she said.
“He’s just good people. He’s lovely people to be around, and we’re all so happy for him that he got this opportunity. A better man couldn’t have gotten it.”

The pair has come a long way since “The Legend of Bagger Vance.” Damon, who had already won an Academy Award for the screenplay for “Good Will Hunting” by that point — as well as earning a nomination for his role in the movie — has gone on to snag three more Oscar nominations, including ones for acting in “The Martian” and “Invictus.”
Theron, meanwhile, won a best actress Oscar in 2004 for “Monster” and garnered two more nods for her work in “North Country” and “Bombshell.”
“The Odyssey” opens July 17. Damon said it was an ambitious project, a fact he was made aware of early on by Nolan, whom he worked with previously on “Oppenheimer” and “Interstellar.”
“He was like, ‘This movie’s going to be hard,’ Damon said on the July 12 Sunday Sitdown. “And I looked at him like, ‘I’ve made, I don’t know 80 movies,’” Damon told Willie Geist.
“And he goes, ‘No.’ He goes, ‘This movie’s going to be really hard.’ He, to his credit, was not lying.”

title: ‘Love Island USA’ Season 8 Power Rankings: The Finale’s Winners — and the ‘Winners in Our Hearts’
summary: TODAY.com’s “Love Island USA” Tess Higgins and Sally Darr Griffin reflect on the Season 8 finale, winners Bryce Dettloff and Trinity Tatum.
story: In TODAY.com’s weekly “Love Island USA” column, content creators Tess Higgins and Sally Darr Griffin break down the latest group of Season 8 episodes, sharing their thoughts on the new bombshells, couplings and dumping. Follow @tessdhiggins and @sallydarrgriffin on their socials to keep up with them throughout the week.

After another record-breaking season, “Love Island USA” has officially crowned its winning couple for Season 8. In a vote by viewers that may not be a surprise — but much to their delight — Bryce Dettloff and Trinity Tatum, longtime fan favorites, took home the $100,000 cash reward.

Bryce, 30, and Trinity, 22, coupled up on Episode 1. Weeks later, they officially became boyfriend and girlfriend during a romantic open-ocean boat date. And during the finale, date No. 2 took their relationship to the next step, with a declaration of “I love you.”

Throughout the episode, the final four couples were wooed by messages from loved ones and celebrities outside of the villa, a montage of sentimental clips from throughout the season and uniquely tailored dates, among the typical “Love Island USA” works.

Aniya Harvey and her Casa Amor bombshell beau Carl Schmidt were the runners-up, while two longtime couples rounded out the results, with Melanie Moreno and Sincere Rhea coming in third, and Kayda Bosse and Zach Georgiou in fourth.
For the final time this season, TODAY.com’s “Love Island USA” commentators Tess Higgins and Sally Darr Griffin dish on the results and reflect on this season as a whole.
Thoughts on the Outcome

Tess: “I think this was the cutest and probably most genuine ‘Love Island’ finale that I’ve ever seen. It really highlighted how much the cast actually seems to like each other, not just as friends but in their relationships, too. I think Bryce and Trinity are great winners. They’re so easy to root for. It was really sweet to see both of them say, ‘I love you,’ to each other tonight.

“It was funny because at the end of Carl and Aniya’s date, my boyfriend turns to me and is like, ‘Well they got a book. How are Bryce and Trinity going to top that? I think Carl and Aniya are winning.’ And I was like, ‘Well, if Bryce and Trinity say I love you, they’ll top it.’ And I was right.”

Sally Darr: “We’ve known for a while that Trinity and Bryce were going to win, so that result wasn’t much of a surprise. The rest of the final four felt completely up in the air though. I could have seen those placements in any order. Personally, I would’ve loved to see Kayda and Zach finish higher than fourth. If it were up to me, I think Melanie and Sincere should’ve taken fourth instead.
Winners in Their Hearts

Tess: “Carl and Aniya are winners in our hearts because that was one of the most beautiful ‘Love Island’ dates. The art department went all out for this one. We had all of those florals, the chandeliers, the books hanging from the trees. The fairytale book was so cute, it had all those watercolor drawings. Even certain words were highlighted in different colors throughout. A lot of work went into this date. And I think it sold their story really well, because Aniya has gotten criticism for not originally picking Carl, but putting it in this fairy tale context shows that all great love stories have trials and tribulations. All of the despair she endured with KC was just her kissing a frog on her way to her prince.”

Sally Darr: “I think Kayda and Zach were just genuinely happy and grateful to make it to the final four. Last episode, they thought they were going home instead of Titi and KC, so making it all the way to the finale is a huge win for them.”
Most Likely to Have a Big Post-‘Love Island’ Career

Tess: “I think Melanie could really blow up especially if she ends things with Sincere. I think a lot of people would be excited to follow ‘single girl’ journeys of Melanie, if that ends up being a possibility. But I’ll also be curious to see if Bryce ends up taking off with his DJ career. It sounds like it’s something he really cares about, so maybe he’ll dive deeper into that.”

Sally Darr: “Trinity. Without a doubt. She is leaving the villa with the biggest Instagram following, and I can’t wait to see what she does next. I also have to give a huge shoutout to Jen and Gal. They dropped an incredible photo shoot on Instagram, and they’re absolutely crushing the post-villa content. They’re doing such a good job of capitalizing on their storylines and character arcs this season. The other islanders should definitely take note.”
Best Moment from the Season

Tess: “For me, the best moment of the season was the start to Casa Amor with the women getting a live feed of the Heart Rate Challenge and the guys not knowing what was happening. That was so satisfying to watch and it really primed the women to want to explore a little bit more in Casa than perhaps they normally would. I know they still didn’t go all out, but think about if they didn’t see that live feed at all. Casa might have been even more of a letdown.”

Sally Darr: “The Casa Amor Heart Rate Challenge being live streamed back to the girls at the villa was easily my favorite moment of the season. It was such a great twist and my jaw was on the floor the entire time.”
Who Will Stay Together

Tess: “My two biggest bets are on Bryce and Trinity and Zach and Kayda, actually. I know that people aren’t super keen on Zach, but it seems like they really do like each other a lot. And I’m curious to see how things shake out for them.”

Sally Darr: “Trinity and Bryce seem especially solid and have a really promising future. But I’m excited to see how all of the relationships evolve now that they are navigating the real world instead of the villa. I will be watching.”

title: ‘Love Island USA’ Season 8 Winners Revealed, Split $100K Prize
summary: “Love Island USA” Season 8 has come to an end with a newly crowned pair of winners and the long-awaited jump in the infamously underused villa pool.
story: “Love Island USA” Season 8 has come to an end with a newly crowned pair of winners and the long-awaited jump in the infamously underused villa pool.

Bryce Dettloff and Trinity Tatum were crowned this season’s winners, as determined by viewer votes. Fans had a four-hour window on Friday, July 10, to cast their votes for the winning pair from the final four couples.
The runners-up were Aniya Harvey and Carl Schmidt, with Melanie Moreno and Sincere Rhea placing third and Kayda Bosse and Zach Georgiou in fourth.
Host Ariana Madix announced the winning pair at the end of July 12’s almost two-hour finale.
Read TODAY.com’s full recap of the finale here.
“I feel like I’m in a dream right now,” Bryce said after being crowned the winners. “I’m walking up here. I’m like, ‘Is this f------ real? Like, what the hell is going on?’”
When asked what they wanted to say to each other, they expressed their love and appreciation.

“I’m just so overwhelmed. I never would have expected in a million years to be in this position right now,” Trinity said, with Brynce adding, “I’m just so grateful to be with you. Like, I do love you so much, and every day feels so special... and I can’t wait for life outside of this.”
Trinity also got emotional and cried as she couldn’t believe the experience she just had. “I’m just really glad I got to meet Bryce,” she said through tears.
“You have won, as a couple, $100,000,” Ariana told the paid, congratulating them on being crowned the winners.

During the finale, the final four couples each went on a romantic date together before giving their final speeches, a “Love Island USA” hallmark that involves formally stating one’s intentions and plans for life outside the villa.
Bryce and Trinity enjoyed an intimate and romantic dinner during their date.
“I wasn’t expecting to be leaving with a boyfriend,” Trinity said, adding that she “genuinely” feels like she can be herself around Bryce.
Bryce added that family day “sealed things” for them, he then told Trinity, “I love you.”
She said it back and joked that she was waiting for him to say it back. They sealed their love with a kiss and a cheers.

Bryce and Trinity first coupled up in Season 8’s very first episode, the June 2 premiere. After initial reservations about their age gap — Trinity is 22, while Bryce turned 30 inside the villa — they quickly locked in on their coupling. In Episode 24, Bryce formally asked Trinity to be his girlfriend, and she happily accepted.

title: Prince William, Kate Middleton Attend Wimbledon With Their Oldest Kids: See The Photos
summary: Prince William, 44, and Kate Middleton, 44, attended the Wimbledon Tennis Championships with their two oldest children.
story: The royal family was in the house for one of tennis’ biggest events of the year.

Prince William, 44, and Kate Middleton, 44, attended the Wimbledon Tennis Championships just outside London on July 12. The couple also brought their two oldest children, Prince George and Princess Charlotte, to the men’s singles final between Jannik Sinner and Alexander Zverev. Sinner ended up securing the victory.

The four, who sat in the designated Royal Box, appeared to be dressed in their Sunday best for the occasion. Princess Kate — who serves as the patron of the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club, a role that has been held by a member of the royal family for decades — wore a flowy, forest green dress.

William and son George, 12, both sported classic suit-and-tie looks as per the exclusive Royal Box dress code. Meanwhile, Charlotte, 11, donned a blue dress with a similar cut to that of her mother’s. Prince Louis, 8, did not attend.

The match was an eventful one, with Sinner beating Zverev 6-7 (7), 7-6 (2), 6-3, 6-4. The win makes this Sinner’s second consecutive Wimbledon title. The Princess of Wales presented Sinner with the Gentlemen’s Singles Trophy.
“There’s no better place to play tennis,” Sinner said during the trophy ceremony.
Zverev praised his opponent after his loss.
“Congratulations to Jannik,” Zverev said. “He showed once again why he’s the best player in the world.”

title: Singer Brandy Shares Emotional Response To Body-Shaming In New Instagram Post
summary: Brandy, born Brandy Norwood, shared an emotional Instagram post about body image on July 11, calling on fans to be “gentler” with one another, adding that “everyone is carrying a story we cannot see.”
story: Amid the internet chatter about Brandy’s health and body image following her recent appearances, the singer took to social media to seemingly address the noise.
Brandy, born Brandy Norwood, shared an emotional Instagram post on July 11, calling on fans to be “gentler” with one another. She added that “everyone is carrying a story we cannot see.”

“I’ve learned that it takes only a moment to form an opinion about someone’s appearance, and a lifetime to understand what they’ve lived through,” the Grammy-winning singer and actress wrote in the emotional post. “Our words have weight. Our judgments have weight. Our kindness does too.”

Fans have been speculating about the star’s health after recent photos from an early July visit to her hometown of McComb, Mississippi circulated on the internet. Brandy, 47, had been in the area to host a community celebration, according to local NBC News affiliate WLBT. While there, she was presented a key from Pike County, the affiliate said.
Brandy wrote in her Instagram post that, perhaps, people have been looking for beauty in “bodies that never change and faces that never age.”

“But life was never meant to leave us untouched. It shapes us. It humbles us. It refines us,” the singer wrote in the post. “Every season leaves its signature upon us. And maybe that’s where beauty has been all along. Not in escaping change, but in becoming through it.”

In the Instagram post, the singer shared that she had stopped looking to her appearance as a measure of self-worth, adding that the outlook has been freeing. She also challenged fans to think twice before passing judgment.

“If this post leaves you with anything, I hope it’s this:Before you speak about someone’s body, before you speak about someone’s face, before you decide who they are by what you see, remember, you are looking at someone’s child. Someone’s friend. Someone’s dream. Someone’s life. A soul,” Brandy said in the post. “And souls have always been more beautiful than surfaces.”
The singer joins many other celebrities who’ve cautioned against commenting on body image. In a December 2024 interview, Ariana Grande slammed society’s comfort with discussing people’s appearance.

“There’s a comfortability that people have commenting on that that I think is really dangerous,” Grande said. “I think that I’m really lucky to have the support system that I have to just know and trust that I’m beautiful. But I do know what the pressure of that noise feels like. It’s been a resident in my life since I was 17 and I just don’t invite it in anymore. It’s not welcome.”
Billie Eilish has also addressed discussions around her body, telling Vogue in a 2023 interview that hearing comments about her appearance continues to be painful.
“I like myself more than I used to, and I’m more interested in how I feel than how they feel. But then also that might be a load of bulls--- because it still hurts my feelings,” she said.

title: Jay-Z Smashes Yankee Stadium Record For Most Concert Tickets Sold In His 2nd Night Of Residency
summary: Jay-Z’s second night of his three-show residency at Yankee Stadium on Saturday, July 11 led to a whopping 45,832 tickets sold, breaking the record for most tickets ever sold for a concert at the venue.
story: Turns out there’s actually a lot of love in the heart of the city for Hov — so much so that Jay-Z broke the record for the most tickets ever sold for a concert at New York’s Yankee Stadium.
The rapper’s second night of his three-show residency at the iconic venue on Saturday, July 11 led to a whopping 45,832 tickets sold, according to a press release about the attendance record.

The performance, which celebrated the 25th anniversary of his 2001 album “The Blueprint,” exceeded the sales of his star-studded first night of shows, which, according to Live Nation, boasted 44,916 fans.
Hov’s Saturday show, referred to as JAŸ-Z 25, was one to remember and featured surprise performances from a number of fellow hip-hop icons. And there was no shortage of stars in attendance.

During his performance of “Renegade,” Jay-Z brought out none other than Eminem, who is featured on the track. The Detroit rapper also surprised the crowd with a rendition of his own 2002 hit single “Lose Yourself.”
Others including Slick Rick also joined Hov on stage. Pharrell Williams ended up performing several songs with Jay-Z, including “Excuse Me Miss,” “I Just Wanna Love U” and “Frontin.”

Big names were dispersed throughout the crowd, from athletes to hip-hop idols to other entertainers. Former Yankees Alex Rodriguez and Robinson Cano were in attendance, according to the press release. Other celebs including Fat Joe, Dave Chappelle, Dwyane Wade, Gabrielle Union, Jayson Tatum and Donovan Mitchell were also in the house for Hov’s Yankee Stadium residency.

While JAŸ-Z 25 boasted record-breaking attendance numbers, the rapper’s previous show, referred to as JAŸ-Z 30 in celebration of the 30th anniversary of “Reasonable Doubt,” was a magical night in its own right. Not only did the rapper bring out fellow icons Nas, Memphis Bleek and Jaz-O, he also had some family members join him on stage.

Beyoncé took the stage during Hov’s first song of the July 10 set, “Can’t Knock The Hustle,” handling Mary J. Blige’s iconic hook. Later on, Blue Ivy Carter, the couple’s eldest daughter, joined her father on stage, playing the piano for the song “Feelin’ It.”

With one remaining show of Hov’s residency at Yankee Stadium left to go on July 12, there’s no telling who — and how many people — will show up for Jigga. Plus, there’s good news for fans outside of NYC: Jay-Z will also be hitting the stage in Los Angeles, London, and Paris this fall. Head to livenation.com for more.

title: Why Matt Damon’s Role In ‘The Odyssey’ Was His Most Challenging
summary: After starring in dozens of feature films, Matt Damon thought he knew what working on a challenging project would feel like.
story: After starring in dozens of feature films, Matt Damon thought he knew what working on a challenging project would feel like.
Then Christopher Nolan tapped him for “The Odyssey.”

In the July 12 episode of Sunday Sitdown, Damon, who plays the titular role of Odysseus, told Willie Geist that Nolan cautioned him about the upcoming epic, saying that it would be difficult to make — even for an actor with decades of experience.

“He was like, ‘This movie’s gonna be hard.’ And I looked at him like, ‘I’ve made, I don’t know 80 movies,’” Damon told Willie. “And he goes, ‘No.’ He goes, ‘This movie’s gonna be really hard.’ He, to his credit, was not lying.”

The two had teamed up before for Oscar-winning films “Oppenheimer” and “Interstellar.” But for Nolan, bringing one of literature’s most iconic heroes to life meant filming the ancient story with a unique, old-school approach: no green screens, far flung international locations and IMAX cameras that created their own technical challenges.
The result was a production that “felt more like an expedition than a movie,” according to Damon.
Everyone was “pushed to kind of the limit of what they could do,” he said. “But the beauty of it is you look around and everyone is going through it with you.”

Damon’s fellow castmates — including Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland and Zendaya, among other stars — were certainly no strangers to ambitious productions, either. But even so, the film pushed the actors into unfamiliar territory.

On top of filming in locations like Greece, Morocco and Scotland with their own natural obstacles, filming only on IMAX posed a unique technical challenge, Damon explained. Because the cameras could only capture about two-and-a-half minutes of footage at a time, the actors had to stop and freeze whenever a scene ran longer so the crew could reload the cameras — a process that took about five minutes each time.
In a recent Fandango interview, “Spiderman” actor Tom Holland said “no experience will be as challenging as making [The Odyssey].”
But as the cast acted, froze and acted again on cliffs and in treacherous waters, Nolan himself was also subject to the challenging environments, Damon said.

“Directing is by far the hardest job on set,” he told Willie. “When you’re out there kind of in the middle of a storm and you’re soaked and you’re cold and you’re like, ‘Man, I’m in discomfort right now,’ it is helpful to turn and see the person with the harder job ... looking like a drowned rat, just as cold, just as wet, and never complaining.”
Plus, given the physical expectations of the film, Damon also had “his own cross to bear” while preparing for the movie at 55, he said.
The film, or as Damon would put it, “expedition,” is set to hit theaters July 17.

title: ‘Married at First Sight’ Season 20 Couples: Meet the 7 Pairings Taking the Plunge
summary: “Married at First Sight” is back for Season 20, and this season promises to be more dramatic than ever.
story: “Married at First Sight” is back for Season 20, and this season promises to be more dramatic than ever.

The Peacock reality series returns for a wild new adventure on Sunday, July 12, featuring more couples (seven, to be exact) than prior seasons. Plus, there’s a new group of relationship experts to advise cast members as they navigate life as newlyweds.

Sparks sometimes fly, but feisty battles also ensue as the new couples attempt to adjust to their new lives as husband and wife. Eventually, they must decide whether to stay together or go their separate ways.
